object.claim_boundary: This contract governs one internal seven-aperture projection over a canonical public-safe demonstration place. It does not create a private household record, survey, inspection, work order, completed remediation, assistance decision, adverse score, public endpoint, whole-product qualification, or canonical task-count transition.

common_law.same_place_identity: Every aperture retains the same canonical place_id, source_run_id, public projection receipt, and build lineage.
common_law.distinct_aperture: Every aperture must change object class, evidence set, geometry identity, reading, safe action, authority, acceptance, and handoff. A crop, zoom, label, or paragraph-only switch fails.
common_law.source_authority: A source or authored record carries only its own claim scope. Public, nearby, regional, authored, missing, stale, and unavailable evidence may not be promoted into a private or local finding.
common_law.geometry: Each aperture has a retained authored or source-backed geometry identity. Unknown geometry remains open and may not be closed by invention.
common_law.failure: Missing, empty, stale, rate-limited, unavailable, terms-blocked, and unknown evidence remains visible with what is known, what is unknown, safe fallback, and accountable next action.
common_law.privacy: Public and private projections remain separate. This candidate accepts only the public-safe place dossier and the explicitly non-private authored demonstration cartridge.
common_law.authority: No aperture may borrow authority from another aperture, source, actor, or visual treatment. External effects require a separate lawful and accountable decision object.

apertures.reading: The Plant aperture treats one living object as care, use, uncertainty, and evidence rather than as a generic product image or fabricated sensor state.
apertures.safe_action: Observe the real plant through a touch check, visible condition, drainage, pet access, and care history before acting.
apertures.authority: The resident may perform ordinary household care within actual household authority. No diagnosis, chemical treatment, sensor claim, or professional direction follows from the authored demonstration.
apertures.acceptance: A real plant action is accepted only when the household actor records the observation, action, time, result, uncertainty, and next check.
apertures.handoff: Escalate persistent uncertainty with first-party observations and care history to a qualified steward or horticultural source.
apertures.prohibited_consequence: No diagnosis, plant-health score, mandatory watering instruction, purchase, field dispatch, or completed-care claim.

apertures.reading: The Household aperture relates living objects, shade, drainage, storage, pets, tools, weather context, and resident acceptance without exposing a private address or resident identity.
apertures.safe_action: Verify private household conditions and resident intent before proposing site access, equipment, labor, material change, or scheduling.
apertures.authority: The resident controls household access and acceptance. Public weather context and an authored envelope provide no entry, inspection, work, or completion authority.
apertures.acceptance: A household proposal is accepted only through an affected-actor receipt covering scope, timing, access, safety, completion evidence, refusal, and next review.
apertures.handoff: Provide a bounded evidence package to the steward while withholding private fields from the public projection.
apertures.prohibited_consequence: No private household inference, resident score, entry, inspection, labor dispatch, or completed-work claim.

apertures.reading: The Property aperture combines public imagery, terrain, and community geometry as context while preserving the absence of a surveyed parcel, roof inspection, utility record, or private site observation.
apertures.safe_action: Use the public context to prepare questions and a lawful verification plan, then confirm boundary, access, structures, utilities, drainage, and hazards through authorized evidence.
apertures.authority: The steward may plan bounded verification. Public imagery and map context do not establish ownership, parcel boundary, condition, access, code, utility, or work authority.
apertures.acceptance: Property context is accepted for operational use only after source scope, date, geometry fit, site authorization, uncertainty, and required field verification are explicit.
apertures.handoff: Return the verified or held property questions to the resident and route public-jurisdiction issues to the program operator.
apertures.prohibited_consequence: No property valuation, surveyed boundary, inspection, code finding, insurance consequence, access authorization, or completed remediation.

apertures.reading: The Street aperture relates public corridor geometry, curb and canopy questions, access, drainage, and street-imagery coverage without filling a missing scene with generated evidence.
apertures.safe_action: Inspect the source rail and request an authorized street or site capture where current direction, visibility, registration, or coverage is missing.
apertures.authority: The steward may prepare a public-corridor verification plan. Provider imagery and map data do not authorize entry, traffic control, pruning, work, enforcement, or a private property finding.
apertures.acceptance: A street reading is accepted only when provider, capture time, heading, coordinates, scene identity, attribution, registration error, coverage, and field-verification needs are retained.
apertures.handoff: Route public-right-of-way questions and source gaps to the accountable program or jurisdiction seat with the exact coverage receipt.
apertures.prohibited_consequence: No street inspection, access finding, work order, traffic or safety direction, property consequence, or fabricated street scene.

apertures.reading: The Neighborhood aperture widens from one place to shared routes, shade, drainage, public resources, source health, and coordination questions without assigning responsibility or condition to a household.
apertures.safe_action: Identify public resources and cross-place questions, then route them to accountable human coordination with source times and affected-actor boundaries.
apertures.authority: The program operator may coordinate public information and assistance within lawful program authority. Neighborhood context does not create household, parcel, enforcement, eligibility, or funding authority.
apertures.acceptance: A neighborhood coordination object is accepted only when participating actors, public source scope, jurisdiction, purpose, offer, refusal, appeal, and follow-through are explicit.
apertures.handoff: Return household-specific matters to the resident or steward and route shared obligations to the named jurisdiction or program authority.
apertures.prohibited_consequence: No neighborhood ranking, resident or parcel score, collective blame, eligibility decision, enforcement, or inferred household condition.

apertures.reading: The Region aperture keeps weather, air, water, incident perimeters, thermal detections, resources, and source failures separate while relating them for human planning and assistance.
apertures.safe_action: Follow named official authorities for time-critical direction and route verified mitigation needs toward accountable assistance and review.
apertures.authority: The program operator may coordinate within lawful regional authority. Regional evidence does not transfer to a parcel, household, insurance, eligibility, enforcement, evacuation, damage, or loss decision.
apertures.acceptance: Regional context is accepted only when source, geometry, time, transform, uncertainty, jurisdiction, authority, conflict, degraded state, and safe-action route are explicit.
apertures.handoff: Return local questions to the appropriate lower aperture and route regional coordination to the named human authority with retained source receipts.
apertures.prohibited_consequence: No parcel-risk score, coverage denial, premium setting, evacuation order, enforcement, loss finding, damage determination, or local condition inferred from regional data alone.

apertures.reading: The Stewardship aperture relates evidence, source gaps, attention, offers, decisions, authority, execution, acceptance, appeal, and follow-through without collapsing the place into one score.
apertures.safe_action: Create a bounded offer or hold that names evidence, authority, resources, purpose, affected actors, refusal, appeal, execution, completion evidence, and next review.
apertures.authority: The program operator may coordinate only within a named lawful program. The authored workflow does not establish a real need, offer, eligibility, funding, decision, work, or acceptance.
apertures.acceptance: A stewardship object is accepted only when the source evidence, accountable decision, affected-actor response, execution receipt, completion or hold, and follow-through remain independently reviewable.
apertures.handoff: Return the accepted, refused, appealed, completed, or held object to every accountable lower aperture without changing its evidence or authority history.
apertures.prohibited_consequence: No punitive score, insurance or enforcement action, fabricated offer, invented eligibility, unreviewed dispatch, or completed-remediation claim.

required_campaigns: one canonical place identity and source-run lineage across all seven apertures
seven distinct object classes and geometry identities
seven distinct evidence sets, readings, safe actions, authority statements, acceptance criteria, handoffs, and prohibited consequences
missing, empty, stale, limited, unavailable, terms-blocked, unknown, and authored-state preservation
contained multidisciplinary review before product integration

prohibited_uses: insurance denial, underwriting, premium setting, coverage triage, or parcel-risk scoring
property valuation, resident ranking, eligibility, funding, enforcement, inspection, or punitive action
evacuation, closure, field entry, dispatch, work order, completed remediation, or safety determination
presentation of authored, public, regional, nearby, empty, stale, missing, or unavailable evidence as a verified private or local condition
public deployment, whole-product qualification, 99-point score, or constitutional task-count mutation
adverse_action_boundary.required_human_control: Any external effect requires a separate source-backed object, lawful authority, named accountable human decision, affected-actor notice and consent where applicable, refusal and appeal paths, execution and acceptance receipts, and independent review.

admission_law: The candidate is admissible only when one exact public-demo build and authored cartridge produce seven complete, distinct, source-bounded aperture records; every dependency resolves; every degraded state remains visible; no private or adverse field enters the bundle; all deterministic and contained-review checks pass; and public and constitutional-count effects remain none.
control_question: Can one canonical place widen from plant to stewardship through seven operationally different apertures without losing source identity, authorship, uncertainty, privacy, actor, authority, safe action, prohibited consequence, acceptance, or handoff?
